requirement: Transfer supported HWP5 body primitive shapes into editable DOCX DrawingML while preserving ownership, geometry, formatting, source bytes, destination OPC structure, safe rejection, Undo/Redo, and durable reopen.

implementation.targetStructure: Editable DOCX body DrawingML preset shape with a unique wp:docPr ID.
implementation.mapping: The HWP5 source model is validated into a bounded portable shape snapshot. HWPUNIT dimensions, rotation, flips, fill, stroke, stroke width, and description are mapped by the existing DOCX shape insertion adapter. Same-format HWP5 structural clipboard remains available.

guardedReleaseBuild.portability: NOT VERIFIED; Nix store runtime dependencies

nativeX11.environment: Linux X11/Xvfb, private D-Bus, IBus Hangul
nativeX11.trustedPointerAndClipboard: PASS for source selection/copy and destination paste
nativeX11.undoRedo: PASS for rectangle, ellipse, line; exact canvas digest restored on Undo and reproduced on Redo
nativeX11.t009: PASS; saved, synced, changedSince=false at revision 9
nativeX11.opc: PASS; only word/document.xml changed; part names unchanged; destination text and preexisting drawing identity preserved; docPr IDs unique
nativeX11.freshDocumentSessionReopen: PASS in the same application process; rectangle, ellipse, and line each reselected as editable shapes
nativeX11.sourceImmutability: PASS; all HWP5 source fixture bytes and ownership unchanged
nativeX11.negativeCases: PASS; rounded shape and malformed payload refused without source, target, revision, or rendering mutation

cleanup.result: PASS; complete, proven, filesystemProven, exit 0, no survivors or process errors

limitations: Only resource-free body Rectangle, Ellipse and Line are mapped; rounded, polygonal, floating, grouped, captioned, media-backed, and unknown structures fail closed.
This is structured-object transfer, not full-document HWP5-to-DOCX conversion.
External Office/Hancom interoperability and Wayland, Windows, macOS were NOT RUN.
Nix-independent portability and committed-root-only build reproduction are NOT VERIFIED.
